1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Fixed chassis guide; only FL is undocked. One moving-foot target at a time, 0.68 m plate radius, 0.78 m lateral drift over 5200 ms. No ballast or support-polygon control.
1.natural_language: Hover over the dust patches on the overhead chart to survey concealed plates and their live forecasts. Surveyed plates stay visible. Survey before WAKE to prepare safely; after WAKE the crater keeps moving during inspection. Wake the crater. A visible fixed guide carries the chassis; there is no ballast or balance control. The other feet are already docked. Move the FL toe to each next numbered plate and then the rim. Each foot stroke takes one second. Aim at the future horizontal position on the 1/2/3-second dashed trail; the whole small toe must fit inside its own ring. The plate keeps moving during the stroke. A missed landing or exhausted extension ends the episode. Escape cancels a held aim before release. Certify only after the undocked feet reach the rim. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. 3.label: medium
3.summary: Four freely supported feet with live weight control; plate radius 0.48 m, lateral drift 0.95 m over 3900 ms, body response 12, topple reserve 1000 ms.
3.natural_language: Hover over the dust patches on the overhead chart to survey concealed plates and their live forecasts. Surveyed plates stay visible. Survey before WAKE to prepare safely; after WAKE the crater keeps moving during inspection. Wake the crater. Shift the gold weight handle so the body stays inside the support polygon, then move each colored toe to its next numbered plate. A foot stroke takes one second; aim for the future location shown by its 1/2/3-second dashed trail. Feet stick to their moving supports, and the body keeps momentum. The lift channel follows the next terrace height; you choose the horizontal landing coordinate. Match the toe to its own next plate with its whole small footprint inside the ring. calibration_status: provisional; human and model calibration pending

parameter_notes.rise: Rendered nominal terrace height only. Horizontal landing, reach and balance checks do not use it; no outcome-physics difficulty credit.
parameter_notes.heave: Rendered vertical motion with compliant lift only. The overhead placement chart and outcome checks use x/y; no outcome-physics difficulty credit.
parameter_notes.guided_legs: D1/D2 only: listed toes begin undocked; the other toes are already on the rim. A visible fixed guide carries the chassis and removes manual ballast and tipping. Moving-plate landing and horizontal reach checks remain.
parameter_notes.survey: V3 information change only: unheld chart-pointer inspection reveals concealed supports within a 0.70 m lens. Earned live forecasts remain visible. No probe quota, physics change, timer suspension or required failed commitment.
